scope: Final test-only GPU pixel parity helper; previous static blockers and requested guards only
verified: A no-draw render supplies the exact prefill comparison; an optimized case must itself change both color and stencil, and a depth-write optimized case must change depth.
The normal mask path uses BGRA8 color, source-alpha blending, and a nonmipmapped sampler; mip sampling is a separate stress variant.
The test VS invokes the actual clipping helper for clipped cases, records clipped tight vertices, and requires a clipped optimized case with visible color and stencil changes.
A shared seam requires visible output in the same optimized case; subpixel cases explicitly require the fallback geometry.
Both x-major and y-major optimized paths require visible output, with non-diagonal positive and negative directions. Four atomic counters have a four-word buffer and are initialized for each render.
Each baseline and tight run compares complete color, depth, and stencil readbacks byte for byte.
